subject: unable to find the standalone jar file

messages.author: e0057fc2a295ef1e
messages.subject: unable to find the standalone jar file
parts:
Hello Renjin Team,

I am new to renjin and I have been searching for the renjin-script-engine-3.5-beta43-jar-with-dependencies.jar file which is mentioned in the documentation. The only jar file I managed to get was  uploaded added to the examples and is 5 years old.

Please renjin team, can you be more clear on the locations links that we can use to download the dependencies, I even tried the maven way to add renjin to my java project it failed to work. I think your library is great but the documentation of how to begin using in your java project is not friendly enough for beginners like me.

Thank you!

messages.author: 42e5316f884713d9
messages.subject: Re: unable to find the standalone jar file
parts:
Hi,

The docs explains it well I think but sometimes a complete example makes things easier.

Take a look at  https://github.com/perNyfelt/renjinSamplesAndTests/tree/master/helloworld
it is more or less a standalone project executing R code in Renjin made as simple as possible.

Note that beta43 is pretty old - use 3.5-beta76 instead.

Regards,
Per
